proven_results: The prescribed exponential survival target violates ensemble consistency at every positive deadline for epsilon>0 and nonzero j.
Any physical experiment has worst-input deadline error at least exp(-6*epsilon*t)*(cosh(2*epsilon*j^2*t)-1)/2.
The sharp binary deadline minimax error is derived piecewise, with transition at 2*epsilon*j^2*t=log(3).
A positive lower bound for worst-input full timestamp TV follows by choosing t=1/(6*epsilon); optimal full timestamp TV is not classified.
The supplied quantum jump instrument has singlet/triplet mixture survival with rates epsilon*(6-6*j^2) and epsilon*(6+2*j^2).
All initial marked rates agree with the classical specification, but survival is strictly greater for perpendicular and antiparallel parents at positive time.
The jump instrument has an almost surely finite first event for the stipulated |j|<1.
limits: No optimal full timestamp approximation is claimed.
A classical preparation label or input-correlated resource changes the premises.
